question.text: A LCR circuit is at resonance for a capacitor $C$, inductance $L$ and resistance $R$. Now the value of resistance is halved keeping all other parameters same. The current amplitude at resonance will be now:

solution.text:
In resonance $Z=R$
$\begin{aligned} & \mathrm{I}=\frac{\mathrm{V}}{\mathrm{R}} \\ & \mathrm{R} \rightarrow \text { halved } \\ & \Rightarrow \mathrm{I} \rightarrow 2 \mathrm{I}\end{aligned}$
I becomes doubled.
